package.description: A better Task Manager for Windows 11, with CPU and GPU temperatures, power draw in watts and battery health.

en-US.description: A better Task Manager for Windows 11, with CPU and GPU temperatures, power draw in watts and battery health.
en-US.longDescription:
Taskvane is a free, open-source Task Manager alternative for Windows 11 and 10.
It shows CPU, memory, disk, network and GPU usage plus CPU core and package temperatures,
GPU and SSD temperatures, power draw in watts and battery health. Processes are grouped by app,
graphs go back an hour with CSV export, and it includes alerts, a startup apps manager and an
always-on-top mini widget. It uses about 0.4% CPU.
en-US.name: Taskvane
